Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your DayAs a Data Steward for Product Data, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that Siemens Energys data assets are managed in alignment with governance standards and best practices. You will actively support and participate in core data initiatives to increase the maturity of the product data domain. Your responsibilities will include supporting the implementation of the data governance framework, maintaining metadata and lineage, data modelling, improving data quality and collaborating with other data governance professionals and business stakeholders to guarantee FAIR data ??? findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable.How Youll Make an ImpactLeverage Siemens Energys data governance framework across the data landscape of the PLM process and the product data domain, ensuring adherence to internal and external standards.Actively drive data initiatives and support IT projects with data architecture expertise.Build up metadata repositories and data lineage documentation to foster transparency and traceability of the applications in the product data domain.Build logical, conceptual and semantic data models to improve the understanding and transparency of data connections across the system landscape.Define and monitor product data related quality rules, ensuring trusted data is available for analytics and reporting.Work closely with the data domain manager, other data stewards and business users to integrate governance practices into daily operations.Promote data literacy and data governance awareness across GT.What You BringA university degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.Proven experience in data governance, data management, or compliance within enterprise environments.Understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality and data modelling principles. Experience in semantic web standards like RDF, OWL and SHACL for conceptual data modeling in the form of ontologies.Strong knowledge of PLM, the product data domain and its interdependencies in an engineering environment Familiarity with governance tools (e.g., Collibra), data catalogs and data modelling platforms and frameworks (e.g. ArchiMate) and semantic modelling (e.g. Protege) Programming experience in SQL, SPARQL, Python and experience in low-code ETL applications (e.g. Alteryx)About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. Siemens Energy offers an outstanding range and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and technology related to digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but were also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur OfficeSiemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is more than just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and growing community. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.Our Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character ??? no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
